Hi Tessa / Vanessa,

We are getting ready to issue a blanket PO to cover the tiered commitment we discussed for Q3/Q4. Before procurement finalizes the PO, we need to confirm a couple of billing mechanics on Redwood's side so our AP and ERP can ingest invoices cleanly. High level: our finance team prefers a weekly invoice cadence (we run payments weekly), but they also require a consolidated monthly statement for reconciliation.

Two quick asks from procurement:
- Can Redwood emit weekly invoices AND a consolidated monthly statement that references all weekly invoice numbers?
- The PO stub must include the following fields on each invoice: PO number, BU code, cost center, project code, GL account, and one line item per calendar month (if applicable).

I've attached our PO template (montclair-po-template.pdf) for field mapping. Also let me know if Redwood requires a specific invoice filename convention or a lockbox/e-invoice endpoint — our AP team can transmit either.

One policy callout: our standard payment terms are net45. If Redwood requires shorter netterms (net30) or holds a portion of payment for SLA disputes, we need to flag that for our legal/finance.

Thanks — we need this clarified before I push the PO through the ERP.

Best,
Susan Hale
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Montclair Health

We can generate weekly invoices with a consolidated monthly statement that contains links to each weekly invoice (invoice numbers + brief description). We also have an e-invoice endpoint or we can deliver PDFs to your lockbox email — whichever AP prefers.

Subject: Proposed invoice pattern for Montclair Health (weekly + monthly recon)

Hi team — looping in with a proposed operational pattern we can offer Montclair based on their template and the net45 requirement:

Proposal (operational):
- Weekly invoices: Redwood will emit a PDF invoice every Friday with a unique invoice number (WW-YYYY-XXXX), referencing the PO number and including the following required stub fields on the invoice header: PO#, BU code, Cost Center, Project Code, GL Account. Each weekly invoice will list the line items billed during that week.
- Monthly consolidated statement: On the first business day following month close we will emit a consolidated PDF statement that lists all weekly invoices for the prior month, aggregated monthly totals, and a reconciliation table mapping each weekly invoice to the single monthly summary line. The monthly statement will also include a net payable amount and a single remit-to/lockbox reference.
- Net terms: We support net30 by default for self-serve customers, but for enterprise deals we can accept net45 to align with Montclair's policy. If Redwood is expected to hold back a portion (e.g., 10%) for SLA dispute resolution, that needs to be negotiated with Sales/Finance — not standard.

Operational notes:
- File format: PDFs with filenames: MONTCLAIR_INV_<invoice number>_YYYYMMDD.pdf
- E-invoice: we can push to a lockbox email or a secure SFTP.
- Metadata: invoices will include PO stub fields in both PDF human-readable header and embedded invoice metadata for ERP parsing.

I'm attaching a sample invoice and patterns doc. The sample shows both a weekly invoice and the matching monthly statement. Please review before we send to Susan.

Tessa / Priyom — thanks for the quick turnaround and the example patterns. Leadership reviewed the proposal and we have the following consolidated position:

- Preference: One consolidated monthly invoice is strongly preferred for our ERP simplicity. Weekly invoices are acceptable provided we get the consolidated monthly statement that ties back to the weekly invoice numbers.
- Payment terms: Montclair cannot move from net45 for this contract line without executive approval. Please assume net45 for the PO.
- Holdback: our policy does not allow suppliers to unilaterally withhold payment for SLA disputes beyond standard credit holdbacks approved by our contracts team. We will not accept a default 10% holdback; if Redwood requires a holdback for SLA, that needs to be raised to our legal team for approval and documented in the SOW.

Next steps (action items):
1) Redwood to send a sample consolidated monthly invoice and one weekly invoice sample with the filename convention and embedded metadata.
2) Redwood to map the montclair-po-template.pdf fields to the sample invoice (highlight the fields in the sample).
3) Procurement will issue a PO once happy with the mapping. Please send those artifacts to procurement@montclairhealth.com and cc me.

If there are material objections to net45 or holdback policy, escalate to your sales leadership and finance; we can set a short call with contracts if needed.

Best regards,
Susan Hale
Sr. Manager, Procurement
Montclair Health
